prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square fashion poster for a premium shirt new arrival campaign. Show a stylish young Asian male model wearing dark sunglasses, a light beige short-sleeve button-up premium shirt with chest pocket, and dark trousers, posed calmly in front of a softly blurred upscale architectural backdrop with pale columns, terracotta walls, and a curved paved walkway. Add huge off-white uppercase text 'PREMIUM SHIRT' across the top, smaller off-white brand text 'BADASS' underneath on the left, and 'NEW ARRIVAL' on the upper right. Place small white product code text 'STNTK714' in the lower-left corner. Style should feel luxurious, clean, and fashion-editorial. Technical style: photorealistic fashion advertising poster, soft natural daylight, warm diffuse sunlight, shallow background blur, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
